Class AsyncFramework.JobInfo

public class AsyncFramework.JobInfo

Public wrapper class providing read-only access to async job information. Used to query job status and metadata without exposing the underlying AsyncJob__c record.

Methods

public String getId()

Retrieves the Salesforce system job ID from AsyncApexJob.

Returns:
    The JobId__c value (AsyncApexJob ID), or null if not yet executed.

public String getKey()

Retrieves the unique JobKey__c identifier for this job.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c value.

public Datetime getLastExecutionDate()

Retrieves the datetime when the job was last executed.

Returns:
    The LastExecutionDate__c value, or null if never executed.

public String getName()

Retrieves the job name.

Returns:
    The JobName__c value.

public String getStatus()

Retrieves the current execution status of the job.

Returns:
    The Status__c value (e.g., 'Queued', 'Processing', 'Completed', 'Failed', 'Aborted').

public String getType()

Retrieves the job type (Queueable, Batch, or Flow).

Returns:
    The JobType__c value (Queueable, Batch, or Flow).

public Boolean isCompleted()

Indicates whether the job completed successfully.

Returns:
    True if the job status is 'Completed'.

public Boolean isFailed()

Indicates whether the job has permanently failed (reached maximum retry attempts).

Returns:
    True if the job status is 'Failed' and ExecutionRetries__c equals MaxExecutionRetries__c.

public Boolean isFinished()

Indicates whether the job has reached a terminal state (completed, failed, or aborted).

Returns:
    True if the job is completed, failed with max retries reached, or aborted.

public Boolean isPending()

Indicates whether the job is pending execution or still in progress.

Returns:
    True if the job is not finished (not completed, failed, or aborted).
